topic: What if the Sun switched off? We would not notice for about 8 minutes, the time sunlight takes to reach Earth.

episode.title: What If the Sun Switched Off?

shots.narration: What if the Sun switched off?
shots.scene: Colourful 3D science lab, glowing Sun and Earth hologram, vertical composition, no text.
shots.action: nova presents a holographic Sun that suddenly goes dark.
shots.mood: Bright cyan lab lighting, dramatic golden glow fading.

shots.narration: Imagine its light stops, but its mass remains.
shots.scene: Colourful lab with a dark spherical Sun hologram beside nova, no text.
shots.action: nova traces the solid outline of the dark Sun hologram.
shots.mood: Curious, violet rim lighting around the intact sphere.

shots.narration: [surprised] Sunlight already traveling through space keeps coming!
shots.scene: Lab hologram showing a dark Sun, a golden light stream and Earth, no text.
shots.action: nova guides a glowing sunlight pulse toward Earth.
shots.mood: Wonder-filled, golden light against deep blue space.

shots.narration: We wouldn't notice for about 8 minutes.
shots.scene: Colourful lab overlooking a holographic Earth with a brightly illuminated daytime hemisphere, no text.
shots.action: byte circles the still-sunlit Earth hologram.
shots.mood: Unexpectedly calm, warm sunlight across blue oceans.

shots.narration: Then daylight disappears, revealing stars even on the daytime side.
shots.scene: Lab hologram of an empty grassy landscape beneath a blue sky, no text.
shots.action: nova sweeps the holographic sky from daylight into star-filled darkness.
shots.mood: Astonished, rich indigo sky and sparkling stars.

shots.narration: [whispers] Earth starts cooling, but it doesn't freeze instantly.
shots.scene: Colourful lab with a dark Earth hologram surrounded by a faint warm infrared glow, no text.
shots.action: nova lowers her hand as Earth's warm halo slowly fades.
shots.mood: Quiet and thoughtful, soft amber fading toward blue.

shots.narration: Without sunlight, plants can no longer power photosynthesis.
shots.scene: Lab hologram of a healthy green leaf beneath a fading golden beam, no text.
shots.action: nova closes the golden light beam above the leaf.
shots.mood: Reflective, crisp green leaf against cool violet darkness.

shots.narration: But oceans release stored heat, slowing the cooling.
shots.scene: Colourful lab with a holographic ocean cutaway, warm amber water beneath a dark surface, no text.
shots.action: nova lifts glowing heat wisps from the ocean hologram.
shots.mood: Reassuring, gentle amber light beneath deep blue water.

shots.narration: [surprised] Earth's orbit continues—what if the Moon vanished next?
shots.scene: Colourful lab with Earth orbiting an intact dark Sun and a small Moon hologram beside byte, no text.
shots.action: nova guides Earth along its unchanged orbital path.
shots.mood: Surprising and curious, bright cyan orbital glow against violet space.

episode.endHook: What if the Moon vanished next?
episode.description: What if the Sun suddenly stopped shining, but stayed in place? Dr. Nova shows Byte why Earth would keep receiving sunlight for about 8 minutes—and why darkness wouldn't stop our orbit.
